analysis.executiveSummary: For a championship-focused contender like Corgi Loaf Baking Co., this proposed transaction is a high-impact acquisition that directly converts bench depth and future draft capital into an S-tier starting running back. De'Von Achane (C-AVI: 97.4, D-AVI: 97.0) immediately elevates the starting lineup at RB1 by +19.4 C-AVI over D'Andre Swift, forming a formidable championship starting baseline alongside Cam Skattebo, Justin Jefferson, Malik Nabers, Tyler Warren, and Patrick Mahomes. Because Wan'Dale Robinson was a bench receiver behind DJ Moore and Christian Watson, Corgi Loaf forfeits zero starting lineup productivity. Conquistadors have publicly placed Achane on the league trade block, making this three-asset offer (a proven starting RB, a startable FLEX receiver, and a liquid 2027 1st-round pick) a highly realistic trade concept for both front offices.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. captures significant net starting utility, upgrading RB1 from D'Andre Swift (78.0 C-AVI) to De'Von Achane (97.4 C-AVI) while preserving all starting FLEX slots. Wan'Dale Robinson was sitting on the bench, making the 2027 1st pick the primary capital investment. Conquistadors acquire a solid starting RB replacement in Swift, a FLEX upgrade in Robinson, and premium 2027 1st-round liquidity for an asset actively shopped on the trade block.

recommended.summary: The submitted transaction is fully endorsed as-is. It aligns perfectly with Corgi Loaf's championship pursuit by consolidating bench depth and draft capital into an elite 24-year-old cornerstone running back.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Corgi Loaf's starting lineup C-AVI increases from 668.3 to 687.7. Replacing Swift (78.0 C-AVI) with Achane (97.4 C-AVI) adds +19.4 C-AVI to the starting core. Wan'Dale Robinson (65.7 C-AVI) was Corgi Loaf's WR5/bench piece, meaning no starting FLEX points are lost.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Corgi Loaf pairs 24-year-old De'Von Achane (97.0 D-AVI) with 24-year-old Cam Skattebo (89.5 D-AVI), establishing a long-term elite RB nucleus alongside Justin Jefferson (98.5 D-AVI) and Malik Nabers (96.2 D-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Roster depth decreases slightly by sending out WR Wan'Dale Robinson, leaving Christian Watson and Tyrone Tracy as primary bench reserves, while 2027 draft capital drops by one 1st-round pick.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: Conquistadors move Achane (97.4 C-AVI) and replace him at RB2 with Swift (78.0 C-AVI), while inserting Wan'Dale Robinson (65.7 C-AVI) at FLEX2 over Juwan Johnson (62.6 C-AVI), resulting in a net starting lineup change of -16.3 C-AVI.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Conquistadors replenish draft capital with a projected mid-2027 1st (79.3 D-AVI) and add 25-year-old receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (83.6 D-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Conquistadors widen roster depth significantly across RB and WR slots in a deep 16-team environment.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: Net C-AVI sent by Corgi Loaf equals 223.0 (Swift 78.0 + Robinson 65.7 + 2027 1st 79.3) for Achane (97.4). While the raw asset sum favors the package, the concentration premium of an elite, young S-tier RB in a 16-team league fully justifies the outlay for a championship contender.

verdict.rationale: For Corgi Loaf Baking Co., whose goal is 'Win Championship', this trade is a slam dunk. Acquiring De'Von Achane elevates starting RB1 quality by +19.4 C-AVI over D'Andre Swift. Wan'Dale Robinson was sitting on Corgi Loaf's bench behind DJ Moore and Christian Watson, meaning the starting FLEX positions suffer zero dropoff. Converting a bench WR and a 2027 1st-round pick into an S-tier starting RB anchor creates one of the most formidable starting lineups in the league.
